The '''golden crown''' is the renamed golden helmet of [[Golden equipment|golden equipment]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It gives 2 armor, has 200 durability and has Fire Protection II. It is repaired with gold ingots and smelts into a gold ingot in a blast furnace.
